title: Origins: Usakin
description: Adds the Usakin to the origins mod. A half-human, half-bear hybrid built on strength and bulkiness
body:
## The Ursakin is a power human-bear hybrid. It is a natural protector, aggressive, and loyal.

### /!\ IMPORTANT /!\
This is both a datapack & resource pack. Please put the zip file in your resourcepack and datapack folder.
This datapack was tested in the Forge port of the Origins mod.

<details>
<summary>🟢 Muscles</summary>

Your thicker muscles have allowed you to withstand many more blows as well as protect those around you while scavenging easier.

- +2 hearts
- +2 armor
- 50% knockback resistance
- +20% attack damage
- Can break any block of hardness 2.5 or less with just your fists

</details>


<details>
<summary>🟢 Honey Lover</summary>

Mmmm... Honey...

Honey gives you an extra shank of hunger + regeneration I for 2 seconds

</details>



<details>
<summary>🟢 Rage</summary>

Your primal instinct take over, anger consumes you as you desperately protect those around you. Your blood rushes and the adrenaline pumps through you.

press [Primary Key] to become enraged
While enraged:
- All entities glow red
- Become much faster
- Press [Primary Key] to damage those infront of you with a 2 second cooldown

The enraged state lasts for 15 seconds and has a 3 minute cooldown

</details>



<details>
<summary>🔴 Heavy</summary>

Those muscles are pretty heavy, so heavy that it impedes your movement by a ton and takes a ton of energy

- 15% slower
- Can barely jump a single block
- +25% fall damage
- Exhausts 3x faster

</details>



<details>
<summary>🔴 Blinding Weakness</summary>

Feeling weak isn't a nice feeling

When you are below 5 hearts you will gain blindness II until you are above 5 hearts

</details>



<details>
<summary>Bear Stature</summary>

You are naturally a bit taller than a regular human.
+0.3 blocks taller

</details>
